name: poll-vote-vertical
title: Poll Vote (vertical)
description: Vertical social poll card: a question in Bebas Neue, two or three answers landing on the seconds the speaker says them, each bar filling to its share while the percent counts up, the picked answer filling in the accent with a check, and a vote count rolling up. Question, answers, shares, pick, votes and every beat are variables; top, center or bottom placement in the reel safe zone; own brand ground or none; holds or fades.
